longTitle.officialTitle: To extend authorization of the Reclamation States Emergency Drought Relief Act of 1991.

main.enactingFormula: Be it enacted by the Senate and House of Representatives of the United States of America in Congress assembled,

section.heading: SHORT TITLE.
section.content: This Act may be cited as the “Drought Preparedness Act”.

subsection.heading: Drought Program.—
subsection.content: Section 104(c) of the Reclamation States Emergency Drought Relief Act of 1991 (43 U.S.C. 2214(c)) is amended by striking “2022” and inserting “2028”.

subsection.heading: Authorization of Appropriations.—
subsection.content: Section 301 of the Reclamation States Emergency Drought Relief Act of 1991 (43 U.S.C. 2241) is amended by striking “2022” and inserting “2028”.
